definitions: A type of nougat confection, typically made with toasted almonds and honey, popular in Spain and Latin America, especially during Christmas.

A Filipino deep-fried dessert consisting of sliced banana (preferably saba banana) and a slice of jackfruit, rolled in a spring roll wrapper, and fried until the wrapper is crisp and golden brown. Often coated with caramelized brown sugar.
examples: She brought a box of Turon from the Philippines.
The Spanish Turon is a traditional Christmas treat.
He enjoyed the sweet Turon after dinner.
